name: Sprout Creator Edition
dof_breakdown: arms 6 each, legs 5 each, neck 2, plus 3-finger grippers
summary: A soft-bodied developer humanoid designed to be safe in shared human space: compliant motor policies let it yield to a push rather than resist it, and pinch points are engineered out. Expression is deliberate too — a 360° full-color facial LED array and motorized eyebrows — on top of an AGX Orin and an AI stack open to the developer's own language models.
notable: Compliant control tuned to yield to contact
Motorized eyebrows and a 360° facial LED array
